description: Retrieval evaluation set (agentic workflows and RAG plan, AG2). Each case is a question and the stored documents a good search must surface: {"kind": "report", "ref": "<report id>"}, {"kind": "filing", "ref": "<evidence sha256>"}, {"kind": "thesis", "ref": "<ticker>"}, {"kind": "note", "ref": "<note id>"}, {"kind": "news", "ref": "<news item id>"}, {"kind": "disclosure", "ref": "alert:<id>"}. Written against the real corpus after the first document_index run (2026-10-11); queries are paraphrased so they share few words with the passage. must_contain phrases were copied from the stored passage. Run `python -m steward.retrieval.eval --k 5` and keep the embeddings only if hybrid recall beats keyword recall. See steward/retrieval/eval.py.

cases.query: How much revenue did the chip equipment maker from the Netherlands say it expects for the full year after raising its outlook?
Which social media company said artificial intelligence is speeding up its main advertising business in its June quarter report?
must_contain: AI is accelerating our core business
